name: Dulux Gloss Enamel Anti-Rust Interior & Exterior Paint
shortDescription: Advanced anti-rust gloss enamel infused with active rust inhibitors, providing heavy-duty corrosion defense and rich gloss for steel structures and doors.
overview: Dulux Gloss Enamel Anti-Rust is formulated to provide an impenetrable barrier against environmental rust, corrosion, and moisture infiltration on metal and timber surfaces. Infused with specialized anti-corrosive chemical inhibitors, it halts micro-rust propagation beneath the paint film, preventing unsightly rust bleed-through and flaking even in humid coastal industrial climates. Its hard-wearing, scrub-resistant finish retains vibrant gloss and withstands mechanical scuffing on heavily handled doors and metal railings.
keyFeatures: Formulated with active anti-rust inhibitors to stop corrosion at the metal interface
High-gloss brilliant sheen that reflects sunlight and repels environmental moisture
Durable cross-linking alkyd polymers resist chipping, peeling, and blistering
Superior scrub resistance: withstands regular detergent cleaning without dulling
Smooth buttery flow allows effortless brushing and uniform roller application
Low odor and low VOC formulation compared to standard industrial enamels
Suitable for both interior high-wear surfaces and exposed exterior architecture

specifications.Drying Time: Touch Dry: 3 Hours | Full Cure: 24 Hours
specifications.Clean-Up: Mineral Turpentine Oil / Commercial Paint Thinner

applications: Outdoor metal staircases, catwalks, and industrial railings
Water storage tank externals, valves, and steel pipes
Commercial entrance doors, windows, and decorative grills
Marine and coastal architectural metalwork requiring anti-corrosion armor
packageContents: 1x Can of Dulux Gloss Enamel Anti-Rust Paint
specsSummary: Sheen Level: Gloss Finish (80 – 85% Gloss) | Coverage: 120 – 140 sq.ft / Litre per Coat
